description: Suggest the dinners to pick for a HelloFresh delivery week for a planner profile (hf_list_profiles): ranks every dish and protein swap on the week’s menu in the profile’s allowed categories by its preferences (kid friendly, quick, adventurous) and premium cap, skips recipes picked in recent weeks, prefers varied proteins (e.g. one shrimp + one fish), favours the user’s favourite recipes, never suggests one they rated 2 or lower, and returns the top picks plus 2 alternates per slot, each with its reasons. Read-only: pick with hf_select_meals.

avoid_indexes.description: Menu indexes never to suggest (e.g. a recipe someone dislikes).

avoid_recent_weeks.description: Skip recipes picked in this many weeks before the week (default: the profile’s avoidRepeatWeeks, usually 4; 0 allows repeats). Read best effort, like hf_recent_picks.

max_premium_per_serving_cents.description: Highest premium upcharge per serving, in US cents (default: the profile’s premiumCapCents; 0 = no premiums).

people.description: Servings for this week only, overriding the profile’s people (2, 3, 4 or 6).

profile.description: The planner profile to plan for, by name (hf_list_profiles lists them; the built-ins are "couple", "family"). A profile sets the servings and meal count, the allowed recipe categories, and what to favour (kid friendly, quick, adventurous) and the premium cap. Decide which profile applies to the week before calling.

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

name: hf_suggest_meals
